toolbarHint: Model list comes from the Zcode config file — read-only here
emptyHint: Configure models in the Zcode client, or edit the config file and refresh

section.builtinHint: Follows the ZCode client config; only one is active at a time — switch in the client. The trial plan requires human verification (CAPTCHA) and cannot be used in this plugin, so it is excluded

builtinReadonlyHint: Built-in channel active (enable/disable in the ZCode client)
providerNoModels: No models configured for this provider
disableHint: Disable this provider (writes config.json; chat model dropdown syncs immediately)
enableHint: Enable this provider (writes config.json; chat model dropdown syncs immediately)

dialog.addBody: Models are managed by the Zcode config file and cannot be modified in this plugin. Add models in the Zcode client model settings, or edit the models node of the corresponding provider in the config file below; refresh this page after changes.
dialog.deleteBody: "{{name}}" ({{provider}}) is managed by the Zcode config file and cannot be deleted in this plugin. Delete it in the Zcode client model settings, or remove its entry from the provider models node in the config file below; refresh this page after changes.

viaSelectedHint: The channel currently selected in the ZCode client (authoritative)
viaFallbackHint: The client-selected channel has no valid credential; fell back to the first usable builtin channel
viaFallbackCaptchaHint: The trial-plan channel requires CAPTCHA (slider) verification, which the plugin cannot complete; fell back to the first usable builtin channel (personal plan / API key)
